title: Projective contact classification and the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture

result.label: Projective contact classification and the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture
result.statement: Proves the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture: every closed connected positive quaternionic-Kähler manifold of real dimension at least eight is homothetic to a compact symmetric Wolf space. It also proves contact-Fano homogeneity and classifies smooth connected complex projective contact manifolds of complex dimension at least three: those with b2=1 are adjoint varieties with their canonical contact structures, while those with b2 2 have underlying manifold P(T^Z) for a smooth projective variety Z .
